column3: NASB supplies “of it” and uses parentheses; “from before” is rendered “from the presence of.”
“Some of” is not rendered; “labor” is rendered “service.”
“Had been standing before” is rendered “had served,” and “bring back word” as “answer.”
“Become good to this people” is rendered “be kind to this people,” and “all the days” as “forever.”
“Bring back word” is rendered “answer”; “some of” is not rendered.
“You lighten from on us” is rendered “you make it lighter for us.”
“And therefore” is rendered “Whereas”; NASB supplies “will discipline you.”
The Hebrew reads “I will make your yoke heavy”; NASB reads “My father made your yoke heavy,” as many manuscripts and 1 Kings 12:14 do.
“A turn” is rendered “a turn of events,” and “by the hand of” as “through.”
The Hebrew lacks “saw”; NASB supplies it. “Consider” is rendered “look after.”
“Stoned him with stones, and he died” is rendered “stoned him to death”; “proved himself strong” is rendered “made haste.”
